premise.claim: A Stateful RoleInstanceSet rollout stalls when fresh-unhealthy instances exhaust the maxUnavailable budget, because the base controller schedules no requeue after the 10s unhealthy window expires.
evidence: unit: TestUpdateStatefulInstanceSetRetriesUnhealthyRollout fails on base with retry=0s (no requeue pushed) — results/unit-head.txt (base run grafts the test onto merge-base c500c963).

live: BASE binary against the cluster — 'Rolling update budget exhausted' at stateful_instance_set_control.go:618 with NO RequeueAfter; updated=0 for the full 35s observation window (rollout never resumes) — results/live-base-timeline.log, results/live-base-signals.log.

findings.summary: Requeue scheduled only from the first budget-exhausted target; a healthy blocker (no unhealthy-since entry) suppresses the requeue even when a different freshly-unhealthy target has a pending window (mixed-config stall persists).
findings.evidence: Canary PASSES on PR head (wait=0, no requeue) — the fix returns on the healthy highest-ordinal blocker and never reaches ord 0's pending window. Harness-bites check: a naive 'scan all stalled targets' patch flips the canary to fail (wait≈5s), then reverted (production diff empty). Note: not a regression — base behaves identically; the fix is narrower than the general stall class.

findings.summary: max(time.Until(first.Add(stableUnhealthyDuration)), time.Nanosecond) — the 1ns floor is effectively dead: once the window expired, isStablyUnhealthy is true -> isFree -> the target never reaches this branch.
findings.evidence: isStablyUnhealthy (line 125) checks time.Since(first) >= stableUnhealthyDuration; an expired window flips isFree before the budget-exhausted branch, so the 1ns floor is unreachable except via clock skew.

liveNote: HEAD: 'Finished syncing InstanceSet' result RequeueAfter≈7.21e9 ns (~7.2s, the remaining unhealthy window); requeue fires ~7s later, RIs become stably-unhealthy -> free -> replaced -> ready=2 at t+11s. BASE: no RequeueAfter, updated=0 for 35s+.
cluster: ACK 3-node (cn-hongkong), KUBECONFIG ~/.kube/config, CRDs v1alpha2. In-cluster rbgs-controller-manager scaled to 0 during the test, restored to 2 after.
